WITH stg_team_game_stats AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM
        "nba"."main"."stg_team_game_stats"
)

, mean_stats AS (
    SELECT
        season_id
        , team
        , team_name
        , season
        , count(win_loss) FILTER (WHERE win_loss = 'W') AS wins
        , count(win_loss) FILTER (WHERE win_loss = 'L') AS losses
        , count(game_id) AS total_games

        
        , round(avg(team_pts), 1) AS team_pts
        
        , round(avg(team_fgm), 1) AS team_fgm
        
        , round(avg(team_fga), 1) AS team_fga
        
        , round(avg(team_fg_pct), 1) AS team_fg_pct
        
        , round(avg(team_fg3m), 1) AS team_fg3m
        
        , round(avg(team_fg3a), 1) AS team_fg3a
        
        , round(avg(team_fg3_pct), 1) AS team_fg3_pct
        
        , round(avg(team_ftm), 1) AS team_ftm
        
        , round(avg(team_fta), 1) AS team_fta
        
        , round(avg(team_ft_pct), 1) AS team_ft_pct
        
        , round(avg(team_oreb), 1) AS team_oreb
        
        , round(avg(team_dreb), 1) AS team_dreb
        
        , round(avg(team_reb), 1) AS team_reb
        
        , round(avg(team_ast), 1) AS team_ast

        , round(avg(opponent_fgm), 1) AS opponent_fgm
        
        , round(avg(opponent_fga), 1) AS opponent_fga
        
        , round(avg(opponent_fg_pct), 1) AS opponent_fg_pct
        
        , round(avg(opponent_fg3m), 1) AS opponent_fg3m
        
        , round(avg(opponent_fg3a), 1) AS opponent_fg3a

        , round(avg(opponent_ast), 1) AS opponent_ast
        
    FROM
        stg_team_game_stats
    GROUP BY
        season_id, team, team_name, season
    HAVING
        total_games = 82
    ORDER BY
        season DESC
)
